items.html:
Stefan Swanepoel is a solid wicketkeeper who bats in the top three for
Namibia. He made the senior squad for the first time in October 1999, aged
18, and went on to open in five out of six matches at the World Cup in South
Africa in 2003.

He also captained the Under-19 side at the World Cup in New Zealand in 2002, hitting a sparkling 142 from 131 balls as his side beat their Scottish counterparts. He followed that with a run-a-ball 49 against Canada to help his team reach the semi-finals of the plate competition.
Alan Curr July 2007
